title: Angular velocity calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates angular velocity ω = 2πn from given rotational speed (300 rpm).

title: Maximum EMF expression
description: Essential: Student derives maximum EMF Em = NBSω with correct numerical value (50 V).

title: Instantaneous EMF function
description: Essential: Student provides correct sinusoidal expression e = 50sin(10πt) V with proper phase (starting from neutral plane).

title: Time substitution
description: Important: Student correctly substitutes t = 1/60 s into instantaneous EMF expression to obtain 25 V.

title: RMS voltage calculation
description: Important: Student correctly computes effective voltage E = Em/√2 (25√2 V).

title: Circuit current calculation
description: Essential: Student applies Ohm's law I = E/(r+R) to find ammeter reading (3.54 A with 3 sig figs).

title: Voltmeter reading
description: Essential: Student calculates voltage across external resistor U = IR to obtain 31.8 V with 3 sig figs.

title: Significant figures
description: Optional: Student maintains three significant figures in final numerical answers as requested.

title: Confusing peak with RMS
description: Pitfall: Student uses peak EMF (50 V) instead of RMS value in Ohm's law calculations.

title: Phase error
description: Pitfall: Student uses cosine function or incorrect phase shift instead of sine for neutral plane start.
